title: Compartment door opened with no command behind it
description: Published on locker/{locker_uuid}/event when a compartment door is observed changing from closed to open without a relay fire that could explain it (ADR-0040). Operationally this is a break-in, tampering, a faulty lock, or a failing sensor. `milliseconds_since_last_relay_fire` carries the age of the last relay fire on that compartment so the backend can judge how unrelated it is; it is absent when the relay has never fired for this compartment in the current client session. No correlation cutoff is applied here — the delta is reported and thresholds live in backend alerting policy.

milliseconds_since_last_relay_fire.description: Age of the last relay fire on this compartment. Absent when it has never fired in this client session, which makes the opening definitively uncommanded.
